objective.statement: Retain current sourced work and revise guidance from observed outcomes without cloning history or constraining unrelated thinking.
objective.owner: The user of this local installation
objective.per_run_success: Relevant current records recalled; meaningful delta or no-change checkpoint saved; observed outcomes reconciled when available.

reference_sources: versioned work records with source snapshots
prohibited_context: unverified assistant suggestions as user approval

freeze.manifest: export manifest.json; SHA256 source snapshots in SQLite

sensor.name: agent checkpoint and optional host receipt
sensor.signal: material changes, applied lessons, outcomes, source drift, completion metadata
sensor.collection: current task evidence plus deterministic CLI; host receipt has no conversation body
sensor.freshness: file hash checked at use/recall; text statements reconciled by agent

comparator.rule: current revision, source freshness, authority, applicability, and observed outcome
comparator.window: one relevant work turn; later outcomes remain pending

actuator.feedback_path: use id -> observed outcome -> independent review -> active or suspended guidance

triggers.condition: relevant task start, meaningful delta, observed result, or substantive turn completion
triggers.preflight: scope root and current user authority; initialized roots only for hooks
triggers.dedupe_key: record fingerprint/revision, use tuple, outcome use_id, checkpoint turn_key, receipt_key

triggers.condition: user asks for recall, review or export
triggers.preflight: select relevant registered roots and inspect gaps
triggers.dedupe_key: read operations; new destination for each immutable export

state.evidence_store: immutable source snapshots in SQLite; selected evidence in export
state.atomic_write: SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactions and unique constraints
state.recovery: re-read after conflicts; retry idempotent commands; retain partial exports and choose new output path

roles.name: executor
may_not: promote own lesson as independent reviewer

capabilities.rollback: suspend or retire current guidance; new revision must re-earn evidence

autonomous_actions: scoped authorized work recording and retrieval

acceptance_checks: current truth not silently replaced by proposal
verification.pass_rule: all relevant checks pass; identity and semantic judgment are attested not authenticated

failure_policy.classification: conflict, unavailable source, unsafe input, missing authority or host coverage
failure_policy.on_exhaustion: stop memory operation and report gap without blocking unrelated useful work
failure_policy.rollback: SQLite transaction rollback; demote faulty guidance; preserve audit history
failure_policy.kill: remove only work-memory host/global entrypoints; retain private data

budgets.note: per routine memory pass, not a token limit on user work; CLI is local/unmetered; no automatic model calls

runtime_safety.idempotency_key: content fingerprint, use identity, observation use_id and turn_key
runtime_safety.concurrency_lock: SQLite busy timeout and transactional writer lock
runtime_safety.side_effect_choke_point: CLI scoped root and explicit new export directory
runtime_safety.tenant_scope: one explicitly selected project; catalog routes without merging
runtime_safety.secrets: never capture; heuristic filter plus human/agent review before sharing

observability.status_view: memory.py status; host_adapter.py status; registry.py list
alerts: report material recording failure or harmful guidance; no per-turn chatter

replacement.atomic_promotion: exact revision transaction with evidence gates; semantic contradiction/impact checks are agent responsibilities
replacement.inactive_history: auditable superseded records excluded from normal recall

learning.promotion_authority: distinct reviewing agent/human, caller-attested; never changing user goals
learning.monitoring_window: each subsequent recorded use; absence of feedback remains unknown
learning.rollback: harmful observation suspends lesson; revised candidate starts over

cleanup: remove only this Stop hook/global section
retain knowledge unless separately authorized to delete
retirement.history_visibility: inactive guidance excluded from normal recall
